intent: PatterTech_Website carries no docs/EOS_FEEDBACK.md, so the first PB-E02 harvest could read nothing from a governed venture. It was seeded before the feedback template existed. Either compile the template into it at the next upgrade, or record in estate/repos.json that the venture is exempt and why. A governed venture with no channel back to the EOS is a hole in the harvest, not a quiet absence. Closed: the absent feedback file is recorded as a fact in registry/PROJECTS.md, which is the recording half of the choice this record set out. The other half is now ruled out, because under ADR-0006 the EOS never writes into a venture repository.
